name: Self-hosted (VDP)
description: Fallback driver: any program that publishes its own policy instead of living on a platform. Contact details come from RFC 9116 security.txt when it exists.

policy_fetch.notes: RFC 9116. A missing file is a fact to record, not an error: many self-hosted programs publish policy as a page and nothing else.

scope_extraction.notes: Text-only program pages. Host rules are candidates until the operator confirms them against the policy.
